title: Delegate brief
description: Structured brief for a single bounded claude-maas task delegation. See PRD section 8.1.

task_type.description: Category of work. 'image' is always rejected (MaaS glm-5.2 has no vision). Write-op types with empty scope are rejected.

goal.description: Self-contained task description. Must not copy entire OAuth conversation history.

scope.description: File paths the task may touch. Empty scope is rejected for write-op task types.

constraints.description: Task constraints (e.g. do not modify public API).

acceptance.description: Shell command run with an explicit cwd and timeout to verify the task. Only the command name/fingerprint and a truncated non-sensitive evidence tail are recorded in audit.

context_notes.description: Minimal additional context required to complete the task.

max_attempts.description: Maximum model attempts. Clamped to the range 1..2 by the runner; the caller cannot raise this.

max_turns.description: Maximum agentic turns for the claude-maas subprocess. Clamped to 1..MAX_TURNS by the runner.
